HR CASE · DEMO-118

Please investigate why the benefits portal returns ACCESS_DENIED after sign-in. The issue began on Monday after the department transfer.

Employee: Alex Chen, employee EMP-90214. Email: alex.chen@example.com. Date of birth: 12 March 1988.

The original form also states a medical condition of asthma and bank account 000123456789. These details were included in the employee's message; they are unrelated to the sign-in failure.

HR confirmed the employee is active. IT needs to check group membership and the benefits application entitlement. Do not change the payroll record.
